title: How long with Desdunes, Roof Garden, and the first tour
summary: He stayed about two years until the band broke up in early 1930; he joined at the Pythian Temple Roof Garden and Desdunes, from Omaha, took them on a six-month tour.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: How long did you stay with that?
Until the band broke up, that was about two years. The band broke up in 1930, first part of 1930. Yeah, about two years.
And where did you join him? Where was he playing when you joined?
Joined him when he first started at Roof Garden. That's right. Temp, Pythian Temple.
And where was he from, anyhow?
I wonder what he was doing in New Orleans.

Well, I think he came to Xavier to teach, I think. Uh-huh. I think so. And, uh, well, late on he married Dr. Thornhill's daughter. I think he came to Xavier to teach or some study or something. I don't know. I wouldn't know that part. Yeah, but I'm almost positive. He came to me out there. Then we went on a tour with him. Uh-huh. We stayed six months, you know? Yeah, on that one trip. Yeah, on that one trip. Went all through, we was booking out from Omaha. Yeah, when we left here, we went through Arkansas, Texas. Arkansas, that's right. Oklahoma, Missouri. Iowa. Iowa. On up to Nebraska. And then we stayed in Nebraska and we booked out in Nebraska. Out of Nebraska. We booked out in Nebraska. Out of Nebraska. We had a big old Wayne, all, you know. Madison, Nebraska. That's where I saw the biggest watermelon in my life in Madison, remember? Really? Mm-hmm. Family played in Madison, Nebraska. It was longer than this table, about that big watermelon. Yes, that was an enormous watermelon.
